_note: DEMO DATA - fictional business. Pricing uses Malaysian market estimates (see pricing._note), not a real company's rate card.
policies: Quotations are prepared by the company after information is collected and reviewed.
Specialist work (mould, asbestos, lead paint, structural damage) requires an inspection.

pricing._note: Malaysian market ESTIMATES in MYR for the demo, checked against public listings in 2025-26; replace with the SME's real rate card. Labour-only painter rate roughly RM0.35-0.45 per sq ft per coat (1 m2 = 10.76 sq ft). Economy ~ Dulux Pentalite class (5L ~ RM164), standard ~ Nippon interior emulsion (5L ~ RM235), premium ~ washable/anti-mould range (price estimated, not sourced). Prep rate ~ RM176 per 8-hour painter day. Prices exclude any applicable tax.
